finance.title: Obsessed with CoreWeave and the AI trade? You're missing out on some great stocks
finance.summary: Today's earnings show there's a cohort of the market that can thrive outside of the data center buildout.
finance.title_cn: 是否对CoreWeave以及人工智能相关股票着迷？你其实错过了一些很不错的股票投资机会。
finance.summary_cn: 今天的业绩表明，市场中存在一部分企业能够在数据中心建设之外继续繁荣发展。

finance.title: United Airlines slashes 2026 profit outlook on fuel prices, but travelers keep booking despite higher fares
finance.summary: United Airlines cut its profit outlook for the year as fuel prices continued to climb.
finance.title_cn: 由于燃油价格的原因，联合航空公司下调了2026年的利润预期。不过，尽管票价有所上涨，旅客们仍然继续预订航班。
finance.summary_cn: 由于燃油价格持续上涨，联合航空公司下调了本年度的盈利预期。

finance.title: Boeing wins FAA approval for 737 Max 10 after years of delays
finance.summary: The 737 Max 10, the largest model in the family, was set to start flying in 2020, but increased scrutiny and other safety issues delayed its certification.
finance.title_cn: 经过多年的延迟后，波音公司终于获得了美国联邦航空管理局对737 Max 10型号的批准。
finance.summary_cn: 737 Max 10是这一系列飞机中规模最大的型号，原计划在2020年开始飞行，但由于各种审查问题以及其他安全问题，其认证进程被推迟了。

finance.title: We're booking big profits in an AI stock and trimming a credit-exposed bank
finance.summary: We making two trades Tuesday afternoon.
finance.title_cn: 我们正在投资一家涉及人工智能领域的股票，以期获得巨大利润；同时，我们也正在减持一些面临信用风险的银行股票。
finance.summary_cn: 我们周二下午有两项交易要处理。

finance.title: Traders are betting Netflix's stock drama may be coming to an end
finance.summary: Current options prices are implying a 9% post-earnings move for Netflix, which is the highest since its Q3 2022 report, when it was priced for an 11% move.
finance.title_cn: 投资者们认为，Netflix的这部股票题材剧集可能即将结束。
finance.summary_cn: 目前各种期权价格显示，Netflix在财报发布后的股价有望上涨9%。这一涨幅是其自2022年第三季度报告发布以来最高的涨幅，当时Netflix的定价为上涨11%。

ai.title: 'The Network Is Our Technology': Akash Ambani Outlines Jio's Growth Plans Ahead Of India's Biggest IPO
ai.description: Jio Platforms will open its ₹30,213 crore IPO on October 21, targeting a valuation of approximately $108 billion. Managing Director Akash Ambani outlined plans to expand beyond telecom into artificial intelligence, cloud, satellite connectivity and 6G. The company intends to use proceeds primarily for debt repayment and future growth.
ai.title_cn: “网络就是我们的技术”：阿卡什·安巴尼在印度最大规模的首次公开募股之前阐述了Jio公司的增长计划
ai.description_cn: Jio Platforms将于10月21日进行30,213千万卢比的首次公开募股活动，预计估值约为108亿美元。总经理阿卡什·安巴尼表示，公司计划将业务扩展到人工智能、云计算、卫星通信以及6G领域。该公司计划将募集资金主要用于偿还债务和推动未来发展。

ai.title: Mathematicians fret as AI solves the unsolvable
ai.description: PARIS - Announcements over the last few months that artificial intelligence models have cracked previously unsolvable problems are shaking to the core top-level mathematicians, who are now asking themselves: where do we come in?
ai.title_cn: 数学家们对人工智能能够解决那些原本无法解决的问题感到担忧。
ai.description_cn: 巴黎——在过去几个月里，有消息称人工智能模型已经解决了一些原本无法解决的问题。这一消息让那些顶尖的数学家们感到震惊，他们现在都在思考：我们该在这一过程中扮演什么角色呢？

ai.title: At UN, India says decision to use nuclear weapons must stay with humans, not AI
ai.description: India has reiterated its no-first-use nuclear policy and called for human control over decisions to use nuclear weapons, flagging concerns over the use of artificial intelligence in nuclear command and control systems at the UN General Assembly’s First Committee.
ai.title_cn: 在联合国会议上，印度表示，使用核武器的决定必须由人类来决定，而不是由人工智能来做出。
ai.description_cn: 印度重申了其不首先使用核武器的政策，并呼吁在决定使用核武器时由人类来做出决策。在联合国大会第一委员会上，印度表达了对在核指挥控制系统中使用人工智能的担忧。

ai.title: Elon Musk discusses AI, robots, and a million-times-larger economy in new podcast
ai.description: Elon Musk has shared his views on artificial intelligence, robotics and the future of the global economy in a new podcast released today, underlining how cutting-edge tools might revolutionize...
ai.title_cn: 埃隆·马斯克在新的播客中讨论了人工智能、机器人技术以及规模将扩大一百万倍的经济体系。
ai.description_cn: 埃隆·马斯克在今天发布的一期播客中分享了他对于人工智能、机器人技术以及全球经济未来的看法。他强调了先进工具如何可能带来巨大的变革……

ai.title: Why AI walkouts are planned at six Massachusetts campuses today
ai.description: Massachusetts students are set to walk out of school on Oct. 20 to protest artificial intelligence.
ai.title_cn: 为什么马萨诸塞州六所大学今天计划举行由人工智能驱动的罢课活动？
ai.description_cn: 10月20日，马萨诸塞州的学生们计划集体离开学校，以抗议人工智能技术的发展。
